transcript.en: Well, I've been talking to managers in a number of businesses, and reading surveys about the future of management.
transcript.zh: 我最近和几个不同企业的管理人员聊了聊，并且一直在读关于管理的未来的调查。

transcript.en: And what I'm going to present in this seminar is a few ideas about how the activity is likely to change in the next ten years.
transcript.zh: 今天在这个讨论会上，我想就未来十年里管理可能会发生的变化，谈谈我的几个想法。

transcript.en: It isn't a scientific, statistical analysis just some ideas for us to discuss.
transcript.zh: 这不是一份经过科学统计而得出的分析，只是供大家讨论的一些想法。

transcript.en: One area I want to mention is business markets, and I'm sure a really significant development will be a major increase in competition, with companies from all round the world trying to sell similar products.
transcript.zh: 我要说的一个领域就是商业市场，我相信在世界各地的公司都尝试销售相似产品的情况下，商业市场将会出现更加激烈的竞争。

transcript.en: Consumers will have much more choice for instance, food products sold in Australia might be manufactured in the USA, China, Finland and dozens of other countries.
transcript.zh: 消费者的选择也会更多，比如，在澳大利亚出售的食品中，可能会有美国、中国、芬兰和其他很多国家制造的产品可供选择。

transcript.en: At the same time, mergers and takeovers mean that governments are actually losing power to major global corporations.
transcript.zh: 与此同时，不断增加的企业合并与收购表明大型跨国企业实际上正在从政府手中夺权。

transcript.en: We can probably all think of companies that exert a great deal of influence, which may be good for consumers.
transcript.zh: 我们想到的可能都是那些拥有巨大影响力的公司，这对消费者来说也许是件好事。

transcript.en: A third point I want to make about markets is that in the rapidly expanding economies, such as India, China, Brazil and Russia, demand is growing very fast.
transcript.zh: 我要说的关于市场的第三点是，在像印度、中国、巴西和俄罗斯这样的经济迅速发展的国家，需求也在快速增长。

transcript.en: This is putting pressure on resources all over the world.
transcript.zh: 这给全世界的资源都带来了压力。

transcript.en: I think businesses are becoming more open to external influences.
transcript.zh: 我认为企业越来越容易受到外部条件的影响。

transcript.en: In particular, companies are consulting customers more and more before making their business decisions.
transcript.zh: 尤其是，很多公司在做商业决定之前会越来越多地咨询消费者的意见。

transcript.en: Companies are finding out what they want and providing it, instead of making products and then trying to sell them, which is the model of years ago.
transcript.zh: 公司如今都是先弄清楚消费者想要的东西之后再开始提供，而不是按照多年以前的模式，先把产品生产出来再试着销售。

transcript.en: Another influence is that concerns about the environment will force manufacturers to extend product lifecycles, to reduce the amount of pollution and waste.
transcript.zh: 另一个影响就是人们对于环境的关注将会使制造商们不得不延长产品的生命周期，减少污染和浪费。

transcript.en: And in some cases, regulation will need to be strengthened.
transcript.zh: 有些情况，管理需要加强。

transcript.en: Many societies are much more fluid and democratic, and the structure of companies is changing to reflect that.
transcript.zh: 很多国家都变得更加富有流动性，更加大众化，所以公司结构也会加以调整来反映这一点。

transcript.en: I think we're going to see a greater emphasis within companies on teams created with a specific project in mind.
transcript.zh: 我想我们将看到，在公司内部会更加强调根据具体项目来成立工作小组。

transcript.en: And when they're completed, the teams will be disbanded and new ones formed.
transcript.zh: 在项目完成之后，这些小组会被打散，形成新的工作团队。

transcript.en: More and more people see work as simply one part of their lifestyle, and not the most important one, and as the workforce is shrinking in some countries, businesses are having to compete for staff instead of being able to choose among a lot of applicants.
transcript.zh: 越来越多的人会意识到工作只是他们生活中的一部分，而且还不是最重要的那部分，随着一些国家的职员总数不断缩减，公司将不得不争夺员工，再也不能在众多申请者中挑挑拣拣了。

transcript.en: Typical examples that will attract and retain staff are traditional ones like flexible hours and something that has been made possible by advances in technology remote working, with people based at their home, abroad, or almost anywhere they choose.
transcript.zh: 能够吸引并留住员工的典型方法中有一些是比较传统的，比如灵活的工作时间，也有一些得益于科技进步而成为可能的方法——远程工作，人们可以在家里、国外或者几乎任何他们选择的地点工作。

transcript.en: Management styles will almost certainly continue to change.
transcript.zh: 管理方式必将继续发生变化。

transcript.en: Senior managers will require a lot more than the efficiency that they've always needed.
transcript.zh: 高层管理人员除了一直需要的高效还要具备很多其他能力。

transcript.en: Above all they'll need great skills in leadership, so that their organisation can initiate and respond to change in a fast moving world, where they face lots of competing requirements and potential conflicts.
transcript.zh: 他们将需要的最重要的能力就是杰出的领导力，这样他们的企业才能在这个快速运转的世界里发起变革并做出反应，在这个世界里他们会面对很多的竞争要求和潜在冲突。

transcript.en: In most of the world, the senior managers of large businesses are mainly men in their fifties and sixties.
transcript.zh: 目前在全球大部分国家，大型企业的高层管理人员主要都是50到60岁的男性。

transcript.en: The predominant style of management will almost certainly become more consultative and collaborative, caused above all, by more women moving into senior management positions.
transcript.zh: 越来越多的女性进入高层管理职位，必然会导致这种占主导地位的管理方式变得更偏向协商合作。

transcript.en: Many of the changes are influenced by developments in the wider economy.
transcript.zh: 这些变化中的很多都受到了更广泛的经济发展的影响。

transcript.en: The traditional emphasis of business was manufacturing, and of course the service sector is very important.
transcript.zh: 传统商业的重心是制造业，当然了，服务行业也很重要。

transcript.en: But we shouldn't overlook the growing financial contribution of IP, that is, intellectual property.
transcript.zh: 但是我们不该忽视知识产权（IP，Intellectual Property）做出的越来越多的金融贡献。

transcript.en: Some books and films generate enormous sums from the sale of related DVDs, music, games, clothes, and so on.
transcript.zh: 一些书籍和电影通过出售像DVD、音乐、游戏和服装等周边产品，获得了大笔收入。

transcript.en: Another point I'd like to make is that although I've been talking about companies, one trend that they have to face is the move away from people working for the same employer for years.
transcript.zh: 我要讲的另一个观点就是，虽然我一直在讲公司的情况，但是他们需要面对一个新的趋势，与以往人们为同一个雇主连续工作好多年不同的一个趋势。

transcript.en: Instead, more and more people are becoming self-employed, to gain the freedom and control over their lives that they're unlikely to get from being employed.
transcript.zh: 越来越多的人开始自主创业，以获得他们在受雇于他人时不太可能拥有的自由和对自己生活的掌控。

transcript.en: OK, well that's all I want to say, so let's open it up for discussion.
transcript.zh: 这就是我想讲的所有内容，那我们现在开始讨论吧。
